t: This is the Memorial to the Brigade of Gurkhas on Horse Guards Avenue, in Whitehall. Queen Elizabeth the Second unveiled it on the third of December 1997. It was the first memorial to Gurkha soldiers in the United Kingdom, marking the move of their headquarters and training centre from Hong Kong to London that year. The sculptor Philip Jackson worked from a 1924 statue by Richard Reginald Goulden, and the plinth was designed by Cecil Denny Highton.
